name: Serialize and durably publish existing receipt resume state

files_create.purpose: Independent failure/concurrency tests of real resume apply publication boundary; no implementation-mirroring assertion.
Describe actual existing API publication/recovery behavior and explicit trust limits.
Reuse approved programme scope and selected durability concept.
Captured execution evidence and role-owned verdicts.

files_modify.purpose: Wrap existing resume apply read/plan/write in one stable per-state lock and atomically publish durable complete JSON; preserve actual plan_receipt_transition proof interpretation.
Run exact existing generic/standalone/start-path and new resume regressions in the current fixtures job; preserve job identity, runner and permissions.

non_goals: No new receipt/attempt authority or completion state schema
No bypass of plan_receipt_transition or existing proof validation
No live state migration, production operation or .nizam modification
No extra receipt counter, new completion schema or execution controller.
No tool/policy/provider changes or task-budget reset.
No unsafe fallback if required platform locking/atomic primitives unavailable.
acceptance_requirements: Independent real interruption before replace preserves old parseable state; interruption after replace yields complete new parseable state.
Two concurrent apply calls on same valid receipt yield exactly one history transition and one noop.
Concurrent conflicting receipts cannot both advance from stale source state.
Read-only run has no filesystem effects, old/new mode preserved, failure refuses with evidence and does not mark applied.
Existing real receipt/recovery and task-wide retry cases remain passing.
Use one stable per-state OS lock in the owned .agent evidence namespace keyed by canonical state target; no adjacent untracked source lock that changes assessed inputs.
Apply locks before reading current state and planning; each contender sees current bytes. Read-only does not create a lock.

Atomic JSON publication fsyncs file and directory, preserves original regular-file permissions and rejects symlink/nonregular target. On any uncertain post-publication failure do not assert applied success; exact existing receipt replay reconciles.
Independent tests exercise real verified receipt fixture for at least one path; controlled publication-layer fault injection may isolate IO but cannot replace all proof with a fake planner.

verification.acceptance_test: Missing receipt recovery preserves original state

evidence_convention: Exact argv/cwd/source/environment, true exits, immutable output streams and source hashes; independent Test Engineer RED before implementation; raw failed bytes preserved losslessly.
root_concept_approval: Root selected resume durability concept 2026-10-30; source awaits two bound precode reviews and independent RED.

approval_evidence.root_authority: Root selected concept and authorized source after both precode verdicts and independent RED; no additional gate.

amendments.reason: Current workflows execute none of test_nf_ac*, test_start_path or new resume suite, so green CI does not protect these source fixes. Workflow path is normative under installed classifier; no lightweight bypass.
invariants: Same existing fixtures_self_test job, runner and permissions
